en.description:
Watch Games — a pixel arcade on your wrist.

Between swim sets, on the commute, or while waiting in line: lift your wrist and start a round. Built for Apple Watch with crisp pixel art and simple controls for short sessions. Play independently on your Watch.

WHY WATCH
• One-hand taps, easy rules
• Pixel art stays readable on a small screen
• Quick start / quick finish for breaks
• Standalone Watch play (no phone in hand required)

GAMES (more coming)
• Palm Pet — hatch, feed, clean, sleep; watch-face widget; care on phone and Watch together
• Pixel Link — match tiles with ≤2-turn paths; boards grow by level
• Coin War — shoot coins straight up and merge
• Screw Relax — unscrew plates and dig endlessly
• Parking Exit — clear blockers and drive out
• Bottle Match — deduce the order from match counts
• Gun Rush — endless side-scroller shooter
• Sushi Belt — sort sushi on the conveyor
• Spit Aim — tap to spit and hit moving targets
• Pool / 4-way Tetris and more
• Punch SFX — punch to trigger hit sounds

ON IPHONE
• Open Palm Pet and sync care with Watch
• View synced scores and clears
• Reorder / hide Watch hub games
• Preview punch sounds, help, and feedback

Open Watch Games on your Apple Watch and play anytime.
en.releaseNotes:
Four new games
• Slice Master: Cut produce close to the ordered weight
• Face Vent: Tap to vent—combos stack the faces
• Traveler: Wrist pet goes on trips; care syncs phone ↔ Watch
• Fever Spin: Place a bet and pull the lever
en.subtitle: Watch Games Pixel

zh.description:
Watch Games —— 戴在手腕上的像素游戏厅

没带手机？游泳组间休息、通勤路上、排队片刻，抬起手腕就能开一局。Watch Games 专为 Apple Watch 设计，像素复古风格，操作简洁，适合碎片时间畅玩，并可在手表上独立运行。

【为什么适合手表】
• 单手触控，规则清晰，几秒上手
• 像素画面小屏也清晰好认
• 可在休息间隙快速开局、快速结束
• 支持 Apple Watch 独立使用（无需一直拿着 iPhone）

【游戏合集（持续更新）】
• 掌心宠：孵蛋喂养、清洁作息，表盘小组件随时查看；手机与手表可同步照料
• 像素连连：相同图案两折连通消除，关卡越大棋盘越大
• 零用钱大战：垂直发射硬币，合并升级冲击高分
• 螺丝解压：拧螺丝揭钢板，无限向下挖
• 停车场出车：挪开挡路车辆，四边驶出
• 饮料对对碰：只报对数，推理还原排列
• 火力冲刺：横版射击无限挑战，越久越难
• 桌球 / 俄罗斯方块（四向版）等经典小品
• 出拳音效：挥拳触发打击音效，运动也能玩

【手机 App 能做什么】
• 打开掌心宠，与手表同步喂养与状态
• 查看手表同步过来的成绩与通关记录
• 管理手表大厅游戏顺序与显隐
• 试听出拳相关音效、查看说明与反馈入口

打开手表上的 Watch Games，选一款喜欢的像素小游戏，随时开玩。

如有问题或建议，欢迎通过应用内反馈告诉我们。

•旅行家：腕上宠物出门旅行，手机手表同步照料
